style:
<style>
#defeso-root{
  width:100%;
  margin:0 auto
}
.defeso-page-head{
  display:none
}
.defeso-search-card{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr)!important;
  gap:14px!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  margin:0 0 12px!important;
  padding:18px!important;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0!important;
  border-radius:14px!important;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.97)!important;
  box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(17,49,60,.05)!important
}
.defeso-search-icon{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:54px;
  height:54px;
  border-radius:15px;
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#176e7d,#168e96);
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(16,106,119,.15)
}
.defeso-search-icon svg{
  width:26px;
  height:26px;
  fill:none;
  stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:1.8;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round
}
.defeso-search-card h3{
  margin:0!important;
  color:var(--pda-ink)!important;
  font-family:var(--pda-display)!important;
  font-size:20px!important;
  font-weight:650!important
}
.defeso-search-card p{
  margin:3px 0 0!important;
  font-size:9px!important
}
.defeso-query-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,420px) auto;
  gap:9px;
  align-items:end;
  margin-top:12px
}
.defeso-query-row input{
  min-height:42px!important
}
.defeso-query-row button{
  min-height:42px!important;
  padding-inline:17px!important
}
.defeso-api-state{
  display:block;
  margin-top:7px;
  font-size:8px!important
}
.defeso-result{
  display:grid;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:0
}
.defeso-result .stats{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  margin:0 0 4px!important
}
.defeso-result .stat{
  min-height:86px!important;
  padding:14px!important;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.97)!important;
  box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(17,49,60,.04)!important
}
.defeso-result .stat strong{
  color:var(--pda-sea)!important;
  font-family:var(--pda-display)!important;
  font-size:22px!important;
  font-weight:650!important
}
.defeso-result .stat span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:3px;
  color:#697a75!important;
  font-size:8.5px!important
}
.defeso-result details{
  margin:0!important;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #dedad1!important;
  border-radius:11px!important;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.97)!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}
.defeso-result details>summary{
  padding:11px 13px!important;
  color:#304f5a!important;
  background:#f7f4ed!important;
  font-size:9px!important;
  font-weight:750!important
}
.defeso-result details[open]>summary{
  color:#fff!important;
  background:var(--pda-sea)!important
}
.defeso-result pre{
  margin:0!important;
  padding:13px!important;
  color:#405d66!important;
  background:#fffdfa!important;
  font-family:var(--pda-ui)!important;
  font-size:9px!important;
  line-height:1.55!important;
  white-space:pre-wrap!important
}
.defeso-result .warn{
  padding:14px;
  border-radius:10px;
  color:#74453b;
  background:#fff0ec
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .defeso-search-card{
    grid-template-columns:1fr!important
  }
  .defeso-query-row,
  .defeso-result .stats{
    grid-template-columns:1fr!important
  }
}
</style>
script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.DEFESO = (()=>{
  const {
    el,card,call,status
  }=App;

  function moneyBR_(value){
    return Number(value||0).toLocaleString(
      'pt-BR',
      {
        minimumFractionDigits:2,
        maximumFractionDigits:2
      }
    );
  }

  function dateBR_(value){
    const s=String(value||'').slice(0,10);

    if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)){
      return String(value||'');
    }

    return s.slice(8,10)+'/'+s.slice(5,7)+'/'+s.slice(0,4);
  }

  function maskCpf_(input){
    const sync=()=>{
      const d=String(input.value||'')
        .replace(/\D/g,'')
        .slice(0,11);

      input.value=
        d
          .replace(/^(\d{3})(\d)/,'$1.$2')
          .replace(/^(\d{3})\.(\d{3})(\d)/,'$1.$2.$3')
          .replace(
            /^(\d{3})\.(\d{3})\.(\d{3})(\d{1,2}).*$/,
            '$1.$2.$3-$4'
          );
    };

    input.addEventListener('input',sync);
    input.addEventListener('blur',sync);
  }

  function recordText_(r){
    return [
      'ID: '+(r.id||'—'),
      'CPF: '+(r.cpfFormatado||'—'),
      'NIS: '+(r.nis||'—'),
      'Nome: '+(r.nome||'—'),
      'Município: '+(r.nomeIBGE||'—'),
      'UF: '+(r.ufSigla||'—'),
      'RGP: '+(r.rgp||'—'),
      'Portaria: '+(r.portaria||'—'),
      'Mês de referência: '+(dateBR_(r.dataMesReferencia)||'—'),
      'Data de emissão: '+(dateBR_(r.dataEmissaoParcela)||'—'),
      'Data do saque: '+(dateBR_(r.dataSaque)||'—'),
      'Parcela: '+(r.parcela||'—'),
      'Situação: '+(r.situacao||'—'),
      'Valor: R$ '+moneyBR_(r.valor)
    ].join('\n');
  }

  function renderResult_(area,result){
    area.replaceChildren();

    const stats=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'stats'
      );

    [
      [
        String(result.quantidade||0),
        'registros de 2025'
      ],
      [
        'R$ '+moneyBR_(result.valorTotal),
        'valor total localizado'
      ],
      [
        String(result.registrosForaPeriodo||0),
        'registros fora de 2025'
      ]
    ].forEach(([value,label])=>{
      const box=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'stat'
        );

      box.append(
        el(
          'strong',
          value
        ),
        el(
          'span',
          label
        )
      );

      stats.append(box);
    });

    area.append(stats);

    if(!result.registros||!result.registros.length){
      area.append(
        el(
          'p',
          'Nenhum registro com mês de referência em 2025 foi localizado para o CPF informado.',
          'warn'
        )
      );

      return;
    }

    result.registros.forEach((r,index)=>{
      const box=
        el(
          'details'
        );

      box.append(
        el(
          'summary',
          (
            r.parcela
              ?'Parcela '+r.parcela
              :'Registro '+(index+1)
          )+
          ' — '+
          (
            dateBR_(r.dataMesReferencia)||
            'sem mês de referência'
          )+
          ' — R$ '+
          moneyBR_(r.valor)
        )
      );

      box.append(
        el(
          'pre',
          recordText_(r)
        )
      );

      area.append(box);
    });
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;

    const head=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'defeso-page-head'
      );

    head.append(
      el(
        'h2',
        'Consultar Defeso 2025'
      ),
      el(
        'p',
        'Consulta avulsa à API oficial do Portal da Transparência. Nenhum cadastro é criado ou alterado.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    root.append(head);

    const search=
      card();

    search.classList.add(
      'defeso-search-card'
    );

    const icon=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'defeso-search-icon'
      );

    icon.innerHTML=
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="5.8"></circle><path d="M15 15l5 5"></path><path d="M8.2 10.5h4.6"></path><path d="M10.5 8.2v4.6"></path></svg>';

    const content=
      el(
        'div'
      );

    content.append(
      el(
        'h3',
        'Consultar pagamento do Seguro-Defeso'
      ),
      el(
        'p',
        'Informe o CPF para localizar os registros cujo mês de referência esteja entre 01/01/2025 e 31/12/2025.',
        'hint'
      )
    );

    const row=
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'defeso-query-row'
      );

    const field=
      el(
        'label',
        undefined,
        'field'
      );

    field.append(
      el(
        'span',
        'CPF'
      )
    );

    const cpf=
      el(
        'input'
      );

    cpf.type='text';
    cpf.placeholder='000.000.000-00';
    cpf.maxLength=14;
    cpf.inputMode='numeric';
    cpf.autocomplete='off';

    maskCpf_(cpf);
    field.append(cpf);

    const consult=
      el(
        'button',
        'Consultar Defeso 2025'
      );

    consult.type='button';

    const configured=
      !!(
        App.state.boot.portalTransparencia&&
        App.state.boot.portalTransparencia.configurada
      );

    consult.disabled=!configured;

    row.append(
      field,
      consult
    );

    const apiState=
      el(
        'small',
        configured
          ?'API oficial disponível.'
          :'API do Portal da Transparência não configurada. Solicite a configuração a um administrador.',
        configured
          ?'hint defeso-api-state'
          :'warn defeso-api-state'
      );

    content.append(
      row,
      apiState
    );

    search.append(
      icon,
      content
    );

    root.append(search);

    const resultArea=
      el(
        'section',
        undefined,
        'defeso-result'
      );

    root.append(resultArea);

    consult.onclick=async()=>{
      const codigo=
        String(cpf.value||'')
          .replace(/\D/g,'');

      if(!/^\d{11}$/.test(codigo)){
        status(
          'Informe um CPF completo no formato 000.000.000-00.',
          true
        );

        cpf.focus();
        return;
      }

      apiState.textContent=
        'Consultando a base oficial...';

      apiState.className=
        'hint defeso-api-state';

      try{
        const result=
          await call(
            'seguroDefesoConsultar',
            {
              codigo
            }
          );

        apiState.textContent=
          'Consulta concluída em '+
          String(result.consultadoEm||'')+
          '.';

        renderResult_(
          resultArea,
          result
        );

        status(
          'Consulta do Seguro-Defeso 2025 concluída.'
        );

      }catch(e){
        apiState.textContent=
          e.message||
          String(e);

        apiState.className=
          'warn defeso-api-state';

        status(
          e.message||
          String(e),
          true
        );
      }
    };

    cpf.addEventListener(
      'keydown',
      event=>{
        if(event.key==='Enter'){
          event.preventDefault();
          consult.click();
        }
      }
    );

    requestAnimationFrame(
      ()=>cpf.focus()
    );
  };
})();
</script>
